text:
maya: quick heads-up — Pilot customers are holding Dedicated until we show per-route economics + compact error views. asking for a small, customer-facing slice this quarter.

tony: proposal: a per-route cost table, simple error-rate sparkline, and a "open trace" link for the top N routes. no span-level aggregation in first ship. estimated: 3 dev days + 2 infra days.

ben: attribution is the blocker. Can we reuse nightly token-attribution and accept ~10% variance for MVP? If not, we need route propagation in billing tags which is more effort.

maya: acceptance criteria: 1) route cost within 10% of nightly baseline for top routes, 2) error signal stable for 24h (no noisy spikes), 3) docs & runbook, 4) one customer acceptance signoff.

sarah: both pilots want a simple what-if slider showing batching/quantization impact per-route as a stretch. OK to defer to MVP-B if we can demo quick numbers.

ton y: sampling plan: deterministic reservoir sampling per-route with sticky sample IDs so traces remain correlated. i'll do a 2-day spike to validate.

ben: infra requests: ephemeral validation pipeline (1 week), and a billing-tag change to carry route id. ops flagged it as doable once ticket exists. i'll open it.

devex-bot: Reminder — update SDK changelog and release notes (assign: @maya).

maya: split: MVP-A = route cost table + error sparkline + trace link (customer beta). MVP-B = what-if slider + sampling controls + richer error buckets. target MVP-A in sprint 12.

ton y: spike card created (#7788). if reuse works, implementation drops to ~3 dev-days.

ben: posting infra ticket and tagging billing/ops now.

sarah: i'll schedule two 30-minute acceptance sessions with pilots and draft pass/fail scenarios.

maya: owners: tony (sampling/impl), ben (infra + tickets), sarah (customer validation), maya (docs & comms). next sync Fri 11am to lock acceptance tests. :thumbsup:
